facts.function: hand instruments used by orthodontists to place, bend, cut and remove wires, brackets and bands
facts.form: hand-held instruments (pliers, cutters, band pushers, etc.)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9018 covers instruments used in dental sciences; Section XV note 1 and chapter 82 do not cover chapter 90 instruments, so heading 8203 pliers is excluded for instruments specialised for dental use
GRI 6: 9018.4 dental instruments > 9018.49 other (not drills/burs) > 9018.49.80 other > 9018.49.80.40 dental hand instruments

rejected_alternatives.reason: general pliers; orthodontic pliers are specialised dental instruments of chapter 90
residual 'other' line; orthodontic hand instruments fit the dental hand instruments line

missing_facts: Are the instruments hand-held (pliers, cutters) rather than powered or machine apparatus?
classification.rationale: Orthodontic instruments are instruments used in dental sciences, named by heading 9018 and excluded from the general tool headings of chapter 82. Assuming they are hand-held pliers, cutters and similar tools, they fall in 9018.49.80 and the statistical line for dental hand instruments, .40. I85144 confirms that orthodontic articles are classified in 9018.49.80 (it used the residual .80 line for non-hand-instrument mixing trays).
